ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three labeled flower structures: A is on the left, with a female symbol beside it, and the flower mainly shows the central pistil; B is on the right, with a male symbol beside it, and the flower mainly shows stamens; C is in the middle, and the flower shows both the central pistil and the surrounding stamens, with a symbol combining female and male beside it. Reasoning: Hermaphroditic means having both male and female reproductive structures at the same time. A corresponds only to the female structure, B corresponds only to the male structure, and C has both female and male structures, so the hermaphroditic one is C.
